dict.string: While the Manager page is open, the helper reads your library (Downloads by default: Manager.html and Manager_Files) and looks for new HTML files. When you import, it writes search details and a thumbnail, moves the file into the library and updates Manager.html. It moves files to the Trash only after you confirm.
If you keep your Manager library or new-files folder on an external disk, the helper reads Manager.html, Manager_Files and thumbnails there, and updates them when you import or confirm a deletion.
